summary: Iteration-5 frontend-only verification of the improved ReHairAnalytics auto-scan (full-screen screen-light overlay, Cancel, timer cleanup) on /upload. Seeded a temp MongoDB user + session_token (test_database) and set the session_token cookie to pass ProtectedRoute. getUserMedia was monkey-patched via page.add_init_script BEFORE app JS, recording constraints into window.__gumCalls and returning canvas.captureStream(10); fetch + XHR were wrapped to record any /api/scan call, plus a Playwright request listener. RESULTS: 34/34 desktop assertions PASS and 7/7 mobile assertions PASS. Verified: (1) getUserMedia called exactly once with {video:{facingMode:'user',width:1280,height:1280}} -> FRONT camera confirmed. (2) torch-toggle and torch-btn absent (count 0). (3) Idle: Auto-scan default (mode-auto has bg-primary), autoscan-panel, region-full/crown/hairline all visible, start-scan-btn visible, light-btn labeled 'Screen light on' -> toggles to 'Screen light off' -> back. mode-auto/mode-manual toggle works. (4) On Start a FULL-SCREEN overlay data-testid='scan-overlay' mounts: bounding box exactly 1920x1080 (desktop) and 390x844 (mobile) = whole viewport; className contains 'bg-white text-stone-700' when screen light is ON. (5) scan-guide shows 'Face the camera straight on' at 24px font; photo counter increments from '2 photos - 5%' to '3 photos - 9%' (real frames captured from the fake stream); light-toggle labeled 'Light on' and cancel-scan-btn both visible during scanning. (6) Mid-scan light-toggle flips overlay className bg-white <-> bg-neutral-900 and label 'Light on' <-> 'Light off' both directions. (7) Cancel: overlay removed from DOM, MediaStreamTrack readyState goes 'live' -> 'ended' (stream actually stopped), start-scan-btn visible again, counters reset, no console/page errors, no error elements. (8) Timer cleanup verified empirically: after Cancel we idled 32s (> P.duration 30s) and ZERO /api/scan calls fired and no overlay reappeared -> timersRef clearTimers() works. Unmount cleanup is also present in code (useEffect return -> clearTimers()+stopStream()), which resolves the iteration-4 review comment. NOTE/CAVEAT: one unintended real POST /api/scan did fire during an invalid sub-test of mine (I tried to click mode-manual while the full-screen overlay was up; Playwright retried for 30s and the scan completed naturally, reaching the 'Analyzing your photos...' state). That is expected behaviour of a modal full-screen overlay, not a bug, but it consumed one real gpt-5.6 analysis call. Backend log showed no errors. Temp seed user + session deleted after the run.

issues: Guidance text uses text-stone-700 on pure white which is intentionally low-glare, but the photo counter is 'opacity-70' on white -> effective contrast is roughly 3.2:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1 for the 14px text. Consider text-stone-600 without opacity for the counter.

While the overlay is up it is fixed inset-0 z-[60] and correctly blocks the navbar/mode toggle; the only exit is Cancel. This is fine as a modal, but browser-back / Escape key do not cancel the scan - adding an Escape keydown -> cancel() would be a cheap safety valve.

action_items: No functional fixes required: front camera (facingMode 'user'), no torch, full-screen white screen-light overlay, labeled light toggle, working Cancel with stream stop + timer cleanup are all verified working.
Optional polish: bump counter text contrast on the white overlay and bind Escape to cancel().
critical_code_review_comments: Upload.jsx AutoScan: timersRef + clearTimers() in both cancel() and the unmount cleanup effect correctly fixes the iteration-4 stale-timer finding - verified no /api/scan fires 32s after Cancel.

Minor: setTimeout(capture, 600) at line 219 is not stored in timersRef, so a Cancel within the first 600ms still runs one capture() after stopStream(); harmless (videoWidth is 0 / frame discarded and framesRef was reset) but store it for completeness.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Camera testing recipe: page.add_init_script replacing navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia -> record constraints in window.__gumCalls and return document.createElement('canvas').captureStream(10); keep the returned stream in window.__streams so you can assert track.readyState ('live' -> 'ended') after Cancel. Wrap window.fetch AND XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open to catch /api/scan. Assert screen-light state on the overlay className ('bg-white' vs 'bg-neutral-900') - computed backgroundColor is unreliable because bg-card is also white in the light theme. IMPORTANT: the scan overlay is fixed inset-0 z-[60] and intercepts pointer events, so any click on page chrome (navbar, mode-manual) will hang and Playwright's 30s retry lets the full 30s scan complete and fire a real gpt-5.6 /api/scan call. Always exit via cancel-scan-btn. Region durations: full 30s, crown/hairline 24s.
